definition: the front of the body below the neck
description: A robin perches on a snow- and ice-covered metal railing in a blizzard, seen close up. Its bright orange breast is puffed out and its belly is white. It opens its beak as if singing, turns its head and closes its beak again as the view moves closer. Long icicles hang from the rail below it, snowflakes blow sideways, and far behind, blurred orange lights glow through the white haze near a dark rock face. Snow settles on its brown back and wings.
